summary: TOOL-1 Login with valid and invalid credentials
description:
As a customer, I want to sign in so I can access my account.

* Valid email and password → redirected to the account page, and the user's name shows in the navigation.
* Wrong password → an error message appears and the user stays on the login page.
* Empty fields → each shows a required-field validation message.
* Password field masks the input.

criteria.text: Valid email and password → redirected to the account page, and the user's name shows in the navigation.
Wrong password → an error message appears and the user stays on the login page.
Empty fields → each shows a required-field validation message.

cases.title: Sign in with valid email and password
cases.preconditions: A registered customer account exists with a known email and password, and the user's name is set on the account. The tester is signed out and on the login page.
steps: Enter the registered account's email in the email field.
Enter the correct password in the password field.
cases.expected: The user is redirected to the account page, and the user's name is shown in the navigation.

cases.title: Sign in with a wrong password
cases.preconditions: A registered customer account exists with a known email and password. The tester is signed out and on the login page.
steps: Enter the registered account's email in the email field.
Enter a password that is not the account's password in the password field.
cases.expected: An error message appears and the user remains on the login page (exact message text not specified in the story). No redirect to the account page occurs.

cases.title: Submit the login form with both fields empty
cases.preconditions: The tester is signed out and on the login page with both fields empty.
cases.expected: Both the email field and the password field each show a required-field validation message (exact message text not specified in the story). The user is not signed in.

cases.title: Submit the login form with only the email filled in
cases.preconditions: A registered customer account exists with a known email. The tester is signed out and on the login page.
steps: Enter the registered account's email in the email field.
cases.expected: The password field shows a required-field validation message (exact message text not specified in the story). The user is not signed in.

cases.title: Submit the login form with only the password filled in
cases.preconditions: A registered customer account exists with a known password. The tester is signed out and on the login page.
steps: Enter the account's password in the password field.
cases.expected: The email field shows a required-field validation message (exact message text not specified in the story). The user is not signed in.

cases.title: Password field masks typed input
cases.preconditions: The tester is signed out and on the login page.
steps: Type a password value, for example 'Secret123'.
Observe the characters displayed in the password field.
cases.expected: The typed characters are masked and the entered password is not shown as readable text.
